title: Apprentice - Various Trades and Disciplines
qualification: For disciplines not individually listed above, candidates must refer to the qualification table on pages 13 and 14 of the advertisement. Applicants must possess the prescribed minimum qualification from a recognised institution. || Additionally, candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act are not eligible. Applicants must not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates with one year or more of training or work experience after the prescribed qualification are not eligible for Technician Apprenticeship.
salary: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on their educational qualification and apprenticeship category. || The apprenticeship training period is 12 months for all trades. ONGC will not provide transportation, boarding or lodging expenses. Apprenticeship engagement does not guarantee regular employment with ONGC.
application_fee: The official ONGC Apprentice notification does not specify an application fee. Candidates must apply through the respective government apprenticeship portal and follow the instructions displayed there.
selection_process: Application Scrutiny:Verification of eligibility, academic qualifications, age and other requirements. || Provisional Merit List:Prepared based on marks in the qualifying examination. || Document Verification:Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates and required supporting documents. || Final Merit List:Prepared after eligibility and document verification, considering applicable reservation provisions. || Engagement Formalities:Selected candidates must complete the required registration, document and medical fitness formalities. || If two candidates have equal merit marks, the older candidate will receive preference. The notification does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination.

title: Police Constable, Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2, Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2
qualification: For the Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2 post, candidates must meet the following educational and technical requirements: || Passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Class 12) examination or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. || Possess a Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate along with one year of apprenticeship from a government-recognised Industrial Training Institute (ITI); or || Possess a three-year apprenticeship certificate in the Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme. || The detailed recruitment advertisements, scheduled for publication on 26 November 2026, should be consulted for all additional eligibility requirements, certificate conditions and applicable recruitment rules.
salary: The newspaper advertisement does not mention the salary or pay scale for the advertised posts. Candidates should check the detailed notifications for information about fixed pay, regular pay scales, allowances and other employment conditions applicable to each cadre.
age_limit: The official newspaper advertisement dated 19 November 2026 does not specify the minimum or maximum age limit for the Lokrakshak and Technical Cadre posts. || Candidates should check the detailed advertisements on the OJAS Gujarat portal from 26 November 2026 for post-wise age limits, the relevant age calculation date and applicable age relaxation provisions.
application_fee: The category-wise application fee has not been specified in the newspaper advertisement. Details regarding examination fees, payment methods and applicable fee exemptions are expected to be provided in the detailed recruitment instructions on the OJAS website. || Candidates should verify the official application fee for their category and selected post before completing the application process.
selection_process: The official newspaper advertisement confirms direct recruitment for the advertised Class-3 vacancies but does not provide the complete selection stages or examination pattern. || Candidates should refer to the detailed recruitment advertisements for the applicable physical tests, written examinations, technical assessments, document verification and other selection requirements, if prescribed for their posts. || The Lokrakshak and Motor Transport Technical cadres may have different selection requirements. Applicants should follow the instructions applicable to the advertisement number under which they apply.

title: Deputy Town Planner; Assistant Town Planner
qualification: M.Arch./M.E.(Civil)/B.Arch./B.E.(Civil)/M.Plan/B.Plan from any recognized university, and a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma course in City Planning/Town Planning/Regional Planning from any recognized institute, or membership of the Institute of Town Planners after passing its examination.
last_date: Post Graduate, B.Arch, B.Plan, B.Tech/B.E, M.Arch, M.Plan, PG Diploma
age_limit: Relaxation as per the Government's rules in force from time to time; the age limit must not exceed 45 years.
application_fee: The fee is paid online by debit card, credit card or net banking. Cash, demand draft, Indian postal order or pay order is not accepted, and other bank charges are borne by the applicant. The fee is not refundable after the online application is filed.
selection_process: SMC will prepare a waiting list of candidates who meet the prescribed qualification, to fill the currently vacant posts by direct recruitment. || Considering the number of applications received, the Municipal Commissioner will decide whether written, practical or oral interview stages are held; his decision is final. || The final selection list and waiting list are prepared on the decisions of the Staff Selection Committee under the recruitment rules for each cadre. || Candidates attend any test at the place fixed by the Appointment Authority at their own cost; SMC pays no travel expense. || If candidates have equal merit, the older candidate gets priority; if age is also equal, educational merit decides.

title: Sub Registrar, Assistant Tribal Development Officer, Social Welfare Inspector, Office Superintendent, Office Assistant, Head Clerk, Senior Clerk and Junior Clerk
qualification: The prescribed degree must be obtained from a university established or incorporated under the applicable Central or State legislation, a recognized institution or an institution meeting the relevant University Grants Commission provisions.
salary: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary ranging from Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 49,600 for the first five years , depending on the post.
age_limit: Applicants must be at least 20 years old and not more than 35 years old as on 30 November 2026 , before any applicable upper-age relaxation.
application_fee: The preliminary examination fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for eligible reserved or concession categories . The notification states that examination fees will be refunded to candidates who appear for the examination. || Fee Payment Last Date: 2 December 2026, 11:59 PM. || Payment Mode: Online using Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through OJAS. Additional transaction charges may apply.
selection_process: The recruitment follows a two-stage competitive examination process: a common preliminary examination and separate main examinations for Group-A and Group-B. || Online Application:Candidates register and submit the application through OJAS. || Preliminary Examination:A common 150-mark objective examination is conducted for Group-A and Group-B. || Shortlisting for Mains:Separate Group-A and Group-B eligibility lists are prepared based on preliminary examination performance. || Main Examination:Group-A candidates appear for descriptive papers, while Group-B candidates appear for an objective main examination. || Document Verification:Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational, age, category and other eligibility conditions.
